mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS trend and 20d SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, which precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS growth and 20d SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) over three months signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and real GDP growth signal a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) weakens consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in more than 45% of cases.
